about: What the three bus actions do with each set of arguments. ONE table, run twice: by
verify-cs.mjs against the compiled actions/ticker-push.cs, ticker-command.cs and
ticker-announce.cs, and by verify.mjs against the mock's copy of them
(mock-sb-server.mjs). The two must give the same answer for every row.
tools/cs/ticker-cases.mjs turns a row into what is sent and what must come out.
Every argument is a string, as the control page, panel-core and the sidecar send them.
push rows (Ticker Push). Before each row the stored payload (the ticker.payload global)
is storedBefore, or nothing when the row says "start": "empty". expect is one of:
accept   the trimmed payload ("stores") is stored and broadcast
sync     nothing is stored; what was stored is broadcast (emptyUpdate when nothing was)
refused  ticker:error with refusedMessage; nothing stored
thrown   the action throws (see "throw"); ticker:error with throwMessage; nothing stored
command rows (Ticker Command): relay is the { command, value } broadcast as
ticker:command, or null when nothing is relayed.
announce rows (Ticker Announce): announce is the { kind, text, duration } broadcast as
ticker:announce, or null when it is skipped.
throw names an argument whose read throws: in verify:cs TryGetArg throws for it with
throwMessage; the mock's /mock/throw switch stands for the same run. The action's catch
block then logs a warning and broadcasts ticker:error with the exception's message.
refusedMessage: tickerPayload is not a JSON object
throwMessage:
stub: this run was made to fail: "quoted" back\slash	tab
line  end

push.name: a JSON object is stored and broadcast as it was sent
spaces, tabs and line breaks round the payload are trimmed; the trimmed text is stored and broadcast
{not json} is accepted: the action checks the first and the last character only, not the JSON
a no-break space and a next-line character (U+0085) in front are trimmed, as C#'s Trim() trims them
a byte-order mark (U+FEFF) in front is not trimmed, but C#'s StartsWith("{") passes over it: accepted, and stored with the mark (measured with verify:cs)
a zero-width space (U+200B) in front is refused
a payload of only spaces is a sync request
an empty payload is a sync request
no arguments is a sync request
what panel-core sends when it connects is a sync request
a sync request with nothing stored broadcasts the empty update and stores nothing
a refused payload with nothing stored stores nothing
the action throws (reading tickerPayload made to fail): ticker:error with the exception's message, nothing stored

command.name: an explicit command and value, as the control page sends them
the command is trimmed; the value is passed as it is
a command with no value relays an empty value
a command made only of spaces, and nothing else: nothing is relayed
a command made only of spaces falls back to rawInput
rawInput with no command: its first word is the command, the rest (trimmed) the value
rawInput of one word
chat: !ticker with the trigger's own command and commandId parses rawInput
chat: every leading ! is stripped (!!ticker)
chat: the chat command is matched without regard to case (!TICKER)
chat: a dedicated chat command relays as its own name, lower-cased, with rawInput (trimmed) as the value
chat: !ticker with nothing after it relays nothing
chat: a commandId with no command argument relays nothing
a commandId of one space is not a chat trigger: the explicit branch relays the command as it is
no arguments: nothing is relayed
__status is relayed like any other command (the sidecar sends its status this way)
quotes, a backslash, a line break, a tab and a control character in the value survive the JSON
a next-line character (U+0085) round the command is trimmed, as C#'s Trim() trims it
a byte-order mark (U+FEFF) is not trimmed: C#'s Trim() keeps it (measured with verify:cs)
the action throws (reading rawInput made to fail): ticker:error with the exception's message, nothing relayed

announce.name: an explicit kind, text and duration
the text is trimmed; no kind is custom; no duration is 8
a kind of one space is custom
a kind the overlay does not know is passed as it is
a raid composes its text from user and viewers
a raid with no user is from Someone
userName and viewerCount stand in for user and viewers
displayName and raiders are the last fallbacks
a user of only spaces is passed over for the next name
a sub composes its text from user
a kind given with a composed text is kept
an explicit text wins over composing, and its kind is custom
no text and nothing to compose from: skipped
a text of only spaces and nothing to compose from: skipped
duration "0" is clamped to 2
duration "5.5" is not a whole number: 8
duration "12abc": 8
duration "99999999999" is too large for an int: 8
duration " 7 " with spaces round it: 7
duration "+12" with a sign: 12
duration "-5" is clamped to 2
duration "31" is clamped to 30
duration "30" stays 30
duration "2" stays 2
duration "2147483647" (the largest int) is clamped to 30
duration "2147483648" is too large for an int: 8
duration "-2147483648" (the smallest int) is clamped to 2
duration "007" with leading zeros: 7
duration "1e3": 8
duration "0x10": 8
duration "+-3": 8
duration "": 8
duration "5" and then a NUL character: 5 (int.TryParse allows NULs at the end; measured with verify:cs)
duration of an Arabic-Indic digit three: 8 (only the digits 0 to 9 count)
quotes, a backslash and a line break in the text survive the JSON
the action throws (reading kind made to fail): ticker:error with the exception's message, nothing announced
